title: 第5章 还不跪下磕头拜见第6章 一丝悔意
slug: 真心待你反被弃转娶圣女你悔啥
lines: read2（）;辰南转头望去，只见一名青年从外走入。
青年约莫二十岁，剑眉星目，英俊不凡。
他身穿云纹锦绣袍，负手而行，气血旺盛，眸光犀利，更有龙姿凤表，好似天降麒麟儿。
萧天麟，萧家一脉少主，紫薇圣地的第三圣子。
身怀麒麟圣体，如今不过二十岁，却已经是神藏境九重的强者。
在紫薇圣地的年轻一代中，也是名列前茅的佼佼者，远不是辰南能比的。
“天麟，你怎么来了？”
见到萧天麟，林轻眉眼中怒火消散，化作绵绵情意。
这种眼神，辰南从未体验过。
爱与不爱，一眼分明。
“我想你了，所以来看看你。”
“只是没想到刚来便看见这种事情。”
萧天麟面带微笑，却虚伪至极，更有一股刻在骨子里的傲气，令人很不舒服。
“抱歉，让你看了笑话。”
“不过你放心，我很快就能处理好。”
林轻眉低声细语的解释着。
萧天麟太优秀了，让她有些自惭形秽。
所以总是将自己摆在低姿态，忍不住想要去讨好。
她告诉自己，爱一个人就应该卑微到尘埃里。
所以她不想让萧天麟看到自己狼狈的一面，想要尽快处理好辰南的麻烦，然后再和萧天麟双宿双栖。
“姐夫，你可一定要替我做主啊！”
林子衿却是如同抓住了救命稻草，连忙起身，委屈巴巴的向萧天麟哭诉着。
而她改口也是极快，林轻眉和萧天麟还未结成道侣，便称姐夫。
这让辰南觉得很是讽刺！
“这件事情说到底，都是因我而起。”
“既然如此，那就让我来解决吧！”
萧天麟轻声安抚，旋即转头盯着辰南，眼神轻蔑。
“跪下，磕头道歉，否则我便打断你的双腿，让你爬着出去！”
轰！
一股恐怖的气息，自萧天麟身上暴起，以排山倒海之势，压向辰南。
那是神藏境九重的强大威势。
一旁的林轻眉和林子衿都忍不住脸色一白，承受不住。
至于辰南，更像是暴风雨下的一林扁舟，随时都有倾覆的危险。
面对萧天麟的强势霸道，辰南眼睛微眯，寒芒乍现。
“你算什么东西，也敢在我面前犬吠？”

read2(); Chen Nan turned around and saw a young man walking in from outside.
The young man is about twenty years old, with sharp eyebrows and starry eyes, and is extremely handsome.
He was wearing a splendid robe with cloud patterns, walking with his hands behind his back. His energy and blood were strong, his eyes were sharp, and he had the appearance of a dragon and a phoenix, like a unicorn descending from the sky.
Xiao Tianlin, the young master of the Xiao family, the third holy son of Ziwei Holy Land.
Carrying the Kirin Holy Body, he is only twenty years old now, but he is already a strong man at the ninth level of the Divine Treasure Realm.
Among the younger generation in Ziwei Holy Land, he is also among the best, far beyond what Chen Nan can match.
"Tianlin, why are you here?"
Seeing Xiao Tianlin, the anger in Lin Qingmei's eyes dissipated and turned into affection.
Chen Nan has never experienced this kind of look.
Love or not is clear at a glance.
"I missed you, so I came to see you."
"I just didn't expect to see such a thing when I first arrived."
Xiao Tianlin was smiling, but he was extremely hypocritical, and he also had a sense of arrogance engraved in his bones, which made people very uncomfortable.
"Sorry, I made you laugh."
"But don't worry, I will take care of it soon."
Lin Qingmei explained in a low voice.
Xiao Tianlin was so outstanding that she felt a little ashamed of herself.
So I always put myself in a low profile and can't help but want to please.
She told herself that if you love someone, you should humble yourself to the dust.
So she didn't want Xiao Tianlin to see her embarrassed side, and wanted to deal with Chen Nan's troubles as soon as possible, and then stay together with Xiao Tianlin.
"Brother-in-law, you must make the decision for me!"
Lin Zijin, however, seemed to have grasped a life-saving straw. He stood up quickly and cried to Xiao Tianlin in grievance.
And she changed her tune very quickly. Before Lin Qingmei and Xiao Tianlin became Taoist couples, they called themselves brother-in-law.
This made Chen Nan feel very ironic!
"In the final analysis, this matter all happened because of me."
"In that case, let me solve it!"
Xiao Tianlin comforted him softly, then turned to stare at Chen Nan with contempt in his eyes.
"Kneel down and kowtow to apologize, otherwise I will break your legs and make you crawl out!"
Boom!
A terrifying aura erupted from Xiao Tianlin's body, pressing towards Chen Nan with overwhelming force.
That is the powerful power of the ninth level of the Divine Treasure Realm.
Lin Qingmei and Lin Zijin on the side couldn't help but turned pale, unable to bear it.
As for Chen Nan, it is more like a small boat in the storm, with the danger of capsizing at any time.
Facing Xiao Tianlin's strong and domineering attitude, Chen Nan's eyes narrowed slightly, and a cold light suddenly appeared.
"Who do you think you are, how dare you bark in front of me?"
